listing.name: Shackles Garrison[XXVII] v1.1.0
listing.summary: Add a mid-tech battle group. Having some vanilla-like ships. Having some special faction weapons, but all of these are build-in their ships.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a mid-tech faction with vanilla-style ships and unique built-in weapons.

description: Introduces the Shackles Garrison, a faction formed from the remnants of the XXVII Battlegroup. They feature mid-tech vessels that resemble vanilla designs but utilize special faction-specific weapons integrated directly into their hulls.
descriptionHtml: Introduces the Shackles Garrison, a faction formed from the remnants of the XXVII Battlegroup. They feature mid-tech vessels that resemble vanilla designs but utilize special faction-specific weapons integrated directly into their hulls.

adding.quote: It will be better if you start your new run after you finish all XXVII missions. Because those missions will give you some reward.
